_comment: R-101 ratchet. Every diagnostic in 02-validate.ts / 03-typecheck.ts that no
negative fixture reaches, with the reason it is not reachable. The gate in
diagnostic-coverage.test.ts fails if an entry here becomes covered (delete it),
if an entry names a diagnostic that no longer exists (delete it), or if a
diagnostic is uncovered and absent from this list (write a fixture, or justify).

uncovered.reason: No surface can produce an anonymous contract: every frontend derives the name from a class/module declaration, and a class with no name is a syntax error in all nine. Defence-in-depth against a hand-written AST, not reachable from source.

uncovered.id: 02-validate.ts:Constructor parameter '*' must have a type annotation
uncovered.reason: Shadowed by 01-parse.ts, which rejects an untyped constructor parameter first with 'Parameter <n> must have an explicit type annotation'. Unreachable through the TypeScript surface; kept for AST inputs that skip the parser.

uncovered.id: 02-validate.ts:Parameter '*' in method '*' must have a type annotation
uncovered.reason: Shadowed by 01-parse.ts, same as the constructor-parameter case above: the parse pass rejects an untyped method parameter before validation runs.

uncovered.id: 02-validate.ts:FixedArray length must be a positive integer
uncovered.reason: Shadowed by 01-parse.ts, which rejects 'FixedArray size must be a positive integer literal, got <n>' while building the type node.

uncovered.id: 02-validate.ts:For loop bound must be a compile-time constant (literal or const variable)
uncovered.reason: Shadowed by 01-parse.ts ('Cannot determine loop bound at compile time. For-loop bounds must be integer literals.'), which runs on the for-statement before validation.

uncovered.id: 02-validate.ts:asm() expects exactly one object-literal argument { body, in_arity?, out_arity? }
uncovered.reason: Shadowed by 01-parse.ts, which emits a longer message for the same shape ('asm() argument must be an object literal { body: <hex>, in_arity?: <int>, out_arity?: <int> }, got ...').

uncovered.id: 02-validate.ts:asm() body must be a hex string literal
uncovered.reason: Shadowed by 01-parse.ts ('asm() body must be a hex string literal or an array of opcode names / push() calls'). The body-shape checks that the parser does NOT make (empty, odd length, non-hex) are covered by fixtures.

uncovered.id: 02-validate.ts:asm() in_arity must be a non-negative integer literal
uncovered.reason: Shadowed by 01-parse.ts, which emits the same sentence with the offending node kind appended, so the validate copy never runs on a TypeScript source.

uncovered.id: 02-validate.ts:asm() out_arity must be a non-negative integer literal
uncovered.reason: Shadowed by 01-parse.ts, exactly as the in_arity case above.

uncovered.id: 03-typecheck.ts:Property or method '*' does not exist on the contract
uncovered.reason: Lives on the member_expr branch (object typed <this>). The TypeScript frontend lowers 'this.x' to property_access, whose own missing-property diagnostic IS covered; member_expr over 'this' is produced only by other frontends or by a hand-built AST.
